avis.texte: Bonjour, le serum est il normalement aussi iquide comme de l’eau ?? On ne dirait pas qu’il est absorbé par la peau ! Je dois en mettre bcp sans savoir si cela marche vraiment et je dois en acheter souvent tellement le flacon se vide vite !!! Est ce normal Mr ou Mme le vendeur ? Merci ! Cordialement
La texture è ricca ma si assorbe facilmente, lasciando la pelle morbida e nutrita senza effetto pesante. Dopo poche settimane ho notato la pelle più compatta, luminosa e visibilmente più tonica.
Vichy es garantía! Llevo años usando los productos y no los cambio x otras marcas!!

This review has been a long time coming... I think I've repurchased this 13 times or more at this point. My skin is very sensitive, extremely fair & goes red at the slightest deviation from my usual routine of CeraVe face wash, Aveeno face lotion, THE END. But after turning 40, I felt I needed to add a lil extra something to keep those forehead fine lines from going any further & ward off some of the other signs of hormonal changes at my age. Obviously, retinols were not an option (& don't even try to tell me about bakuchiol LOL)! Well, hello HOLY GRAIL. This oil in water "serum" has a thinner consistency that mimics skin's natural oil/water balance - my skin drinks it up! It has cleared, brightened & moisturized my face without any adverse reactions from day 1. I use it at night before my face lotion & in the morning alone under makeup to get that dewey hydrated glow. It's wonderful! I get so many compliments on my complexion now. Highly recommend!!!
